name: reschedule_appointment
description: Move an existing booked appointment to a new live-checked slot. MANDATORY: call search_availability for the caller's newly requested day/time FIRST, in this same turn sequence, before calling this tool -- never call reschedule_appointment reusing practitioner_id/branch_id/appointment_type_id/start_time from the appointment being replaced or from an earlier search; doing so returns a conflict error. Copy practitioner_id, branch_id, appointment_type_id, and start_time UNCHANGED from ONE slot object in that fresh search_availability result -- start_time is UTC and looks nothing like the spoken local time (start_time_display); never reconstruct, retime, or guess it. If the returned slot's start_time_display falls on a different day than the caller requested, say the actual day/date returned, not the day the caller asked for. Mention a cancellation fee ONLY when the tool response says cancellation_fee.applicable is true.
execution_message_description: Exactly one short phrase, e.g. 'One moment.' / 'Just a second.' (or Hindi: 'Ek pal.'). Never say 'rescheduling', 'moving', or name the appointment.

caller_full_name.description: Caller full name matching the patient on the appointment.

practitioner_id.description: Required. Copy unchanged from practitioner_id in the same selected search_availability slot.

practitioner_name.description: Doctor name only when practitioner_id is unavailable.

branch_id.description: Required. Copy unchanged from branch_id in the same selected search_availability slot.

branch_name.description: Branch name only when branch_id is unavailable.

appointment_type_id.description: Required. Copy unchanged from appointment_type_id in the same selected search_availability slot.

appointment_type_name.description: Appointment type name only when appointment_type_id is unavailable.

start_time.description: Required. Copy the complete ISO-8601 UTC timestamp unchanged from start_time in the same selected search_availability slot. This is NOT the same string as start_time_display -- never derive it from the local time you spoke aloud.
